title: Photo required if Not OK: off by default, checked on submit
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with "Settings - Service" enabled, on the build under test.
  2. Photo upload is available to the technician; a template has a checkbox field with "Photo required if Not OK" turned on (seed via Settings - Service > Inspection Templates > Add field > Checkbox, then turn the option on).
  3. You are filling an inspection against that template: open a work order, start the inspection, with "Work order lines - Create & Edit" enabled.
custom_steps:
1. In the template builder, add a Checkbox field, open its options, and read the "Photo required if Not OK" option and its default.
  2. As technician, mark it Not OK with no photo and try to Submit.
  3. Check the outstanding-items list before submit.
  4. Check whether the option appears on a per-axle field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A checkbox field's authoring options include an option, "Photo required if Not OK".
  • That option is off by default for a newly added checkbox field.
  • With the option on, choosing Not OK requires at least one photo before the inspection can be submitted, enforced at Submit (not only while filling).
  • Before submit, the field appears in the outstanding-items list.
  • The option applies to checkbox fields only; a per-axle field records a verdict per position, with no single position a field photo would belong to.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9440 (S17 — Require a photo on a Not OK response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S17; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S17-R1: “A checkbox field will offer an authoring option, "Photo required if Not OK"”
  • S17-R2: “The option will be off by default for newly added checkbox fields, starters included”
  • S17-R3: “When the option is on and the technician selects Not OK, at least one photo will be required before the inspection can be submitted”
  • S17-R4: “The system will enforce the requirement on submit, not only while the technician is filling the form”
  • S17-R5: “Before submit, the technician will see the field listed among the outstanding items, so they are not rejected by an error they could have avoided”
  • S17-R6: “The option applies to checkbox fields only. A per-axle field records a verdict per position, and there is no single position a photo of the field would belong to”

Amended on 3 October 2026
S17-R2 changed from on to off by default: Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905 (last modified 29 September 2026, read on 2 October 2026), and Jira SV-9440 updated to match. The S17-R2 quote above is the current wording. Because a new checkbox field no longer has the option on, the precondition now says the template's checkbox field has it turned on, so the Not OK steps still test the rule. The build last checked, v26.36.8-2a64085, still defaults the option on; story defect SV-10789 is open, so the automated E2E check for this expectation (submission-rules-photo.spec.ts, C88510) fails until it is fixed.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
